projects.title: DigitalSewa
projects.description: Nepal's hyperlocal freelancing platform connecting service providers and clients across 20+ cities.
projects.longDescription: DigitalSewa is a full-stack freelancing platform built specifically for Nepal's gig economy. It supports NPR payments via Khalti and eSewa, connects 500+ freelancers across 20+ cities, and features real-time messaging, review systems, and admin dashboards. Built entirely solo from concept to production — handling architecture, UI/UX, backend, and deployment.

projects.title: NASA Space Apps Project
projects.description: Award-winning project at NASA Space Apps Challenge 2024 — Kathmandu chapter.
projects.longDescription: Developed a solution for NASA Space Apps Challenge 2024 that earned the Galactic Problem Solver Award. The project tackled real-world space-data challenges, integrating NASA open APIs and data visualization techniques to present meaningful insights for community use.

projects.title: ERP System (Frappe/ERPNext)
projects.description: Enterprise resource planning system implementation for CAS Trading House.
projects.longDescription: Customized and deployed a full ERP solution using Frappe Framework and ERPNext for CAS Trading House, Kathmandu. Includes inventory management, HR modules, and custom report generation tailored to Nepali business requirements.

projects.title: Generative AI Research Paper
projects.description: Research paper on practical Generative AI applications in emerging markets.
projects.longDescription: An in-progress research paper examining the applications and limitations of Generative AI in emerging market contexts, with a focus on South Asian use cases. Covers LLMs, diffusion models, and ethical considerations for AI deployment in resource-constrained environments.
